messages.充電回数を消耗するたびに充電(威力)が育ち、戦闘が長引くほどスキルが強くなる充電: A Charge Identity whose Charge Potency grows whenever he spends Charge Count, strengthening his skills over longer battles. Photoelectricity also helps replenish allies' Charge Count.
messages.充電を育てる: バトルパッシブ「モデルL37充電」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取: **Growing Charge**: Through the combat passive Charge Model L37 (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains 1 Charge each time he spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count during battle. At Turn End, he gains 1 Haste next turn with 2 or more Charge, and 1 more Haste plus 1 Clash Power Up with 3 or more.
messages.S2「光電標識」: 使用時に充電回数を10消耗し、コイン威力+1/+2。充電回数: **S2 — Photoelectric Mark**: Spends 10 Charge Count on use for +1/+2 Coin Power. With 5–9 Charge Count, he spends HP equal to 2×(10 − current Charge Count)% of max HP to make up the difference to 10. If it spent Charge, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 2 Defense Level Down. Coin Ⅲ inflicts Photoelectricity equal to his Charge, up to 2/3.
messages.充電回数の補充: 主な補充源は4つ。S3「光電銛」はⅡコインの的中で5/7、Ⅲコ: **Replenishing Charge Count**: There are four main sources. S3 Photoelectric Harpoon adds 5/7 on Coin Ⅱ hit and Charge×3 (up to 9) on Coin Ⅲ hit. The Defense skill Charge adds 3 on use (once/twice per turn). The others are the increase from attacking enemies with Photoelectricity and S2's HP-paid top-up. S1 40S-2 Activation spends 5 on use for +1 Coin Power and only returns 2 each on Coin Ⅰ and Ⅱ hits, for a net of −1. It does not replenish Count, but it does add to the cumulative amount spent. S1's and S3's Coin effects trigger on hit, so they gain nothing if the Coins are broken.
messages.S3「光電銛」: 充電に応じてコイン威力が上がる(最大2)。Ⅳコインで光電(最大: **S3 — Photoelectric Harpoon**: Coin Power rises with Charge, up to 2. Coin Ⅳ inflicts Photoelectricity (up to 3) and 1 Blunt Fragility per 2 Charge, up to 2.
messages.光電: 光電を持つ敵が被ダメージを受けると、攻撃者の充電回数が光電の数値だけ増え: **Photoelectricity**: When an enemy with Photoelectricity takes damage, the attacker's Charge Count increases by the Photoelectricity value (once per skill). If the attacker has 5 or less Charge Count, it increases by 3 more. It disappears at Turn End.
messages.S3・守備・光電で充電回数を補充し、S2(とS1)で消耗する流れを繰り返して、累: Replenish Charge Count with S3, his Defense skill, and Photoelectricity, then spend it with S2 (and S1), repeating the cycle to grow Charge through the cumulative amount spent. As Charge grows, he gains Haste and Clash Power Up, and his skills become stronger. When allies attack enemies with Photoelectricity, their Charge Count increases too. Early on, his Clash Power is low and he tends to stumble. He pairs well as an aide to Faust's MultiCrack Office Rep, supplying both Envy and Photoelectricity. His support passive Charging Module Installation (7 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +5 maximum Charge Count to the ally first in team order.
